sentences.text:
Heard on I.A.No.16673/2024, first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant - Devilal Bheel.
Present appellant has been convicted under Sections 366, 366 and 376 (2) (N) of IPC and sentenced to undergo 5 years' RI with fine of Rs.2000/-, 07 years' RI with fine of Rs.3000/- and Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.5000/- respectively with default stipulations vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 29.09.2018 passed passed in Sessions Trial No.49/2017 by First Additional Sessions Judge, Sheopur, District Sheopur.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that there is a delay of three years in lodging an FIR and in counter blast, appellant Devilal lodged a report against the father, mother and other relatives of prosecutrix regarding rape of niece which has been admitted by mother (PW-1) and father(PW-2) of prosecutrix in cross examination.
Appellant has not committed any offence and he has falsely been implicated in the matter.
He is in custody since last 07 years.
It is also submitted that the appeal is of the year 2018 and there is no likelihood of early hearing of the appeal in the near future.
On such ground, learned counsel for the appellant prays for suspension of sentence.

Per contra , learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the 2 CRA-8860-2018 respondent/State prays for rejection of the application with submission that looking to the nature and gravity of offence, no case is made out for grant of benefit of suspension of sentence to present appellant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that final conclusion of the appeal will take considerable long time and without commenting on the merits of the case, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of present appellant.
